project.name: cargotracker

tour.title: Domain Overview: The Handling Glossary
tour.description: Start with the ubiquitous-language glossary. It defines handling events, handling history and related terms that the whole cargo-tracking domain uses.

tour.title: Project Entry Points and Settings
tour.description: Django settings register the four bounded-context apps (cargo, handling, location, voyage). The root URLconf routes requests to the tracking view, and WSGI/ASGI expose the app.

tour.title: Cargo Aggregate and Its Value Objects
tour.description: The Cargo aggregate root is identified by a TrackingId. It composes RouteSpecification, Itinerary, Leg and Delivery value objects, which derive transport status and routing state.

tour.title: Handling Context: Events and History
tour.description: Handling events record what happened to cargo. HandlingHistory is an immutable, time-ordered, de-duplicated collection that drives delivery calculation.

tour.title: Location and Voyage Contexts
tour.description: Locations are identified by a validated UN/LOCODE. Voyages are aggregates with a Schedule of CarrierMovements, assembled through a fluent builder.

tour.title: Persistence: ORM Models and Repositories
tour.description: Infrastructure adapters implement the domain repository ports with the Django ORM. The models.py shims let Django discover each context's records, and migrations create the tables.

tour.title: Application Services and Composition Root
tour.description: The tracking service looks up a cargo and its handling history by tracking ID. The composition root wires concrete Django repositories into it, and map_status maps cargo state to a status code.

tour.title: Tracking Views and Presentation Helpers
tour.description: The tracking view validates the form, calls the application service, and assembles display data. Small helpers format status, ETA, next activity and history.

tour.title: HTML Templates and HTMX
tour.description: The base layout loads Tailwind and htmx. The track page submits the form via htmx and swaps in the result partial.

tour.title: Map Feature
tour.description: The map sub-feature turns a cargo's locations into markers using a UN/LOCODE coordinate table. An adapter builds the iframe URL, and a Leaflet template renders the map.

tour.title: Sample Data Seeding
tour.description: A service builds deterministic sample cargos, locations, voyages and events. A management command wires in the Django repositories to seed a database for exploring the app.
